summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports quarterly earnings, balance sheet items, and segment data under IFRS. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. The Form 6-K is a routine periodic report of financial results for a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms or transaction-specific details to report.
